blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَوْسِ بْنِ أَوْسِ نِ الثَّقَفِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنْ غَسَّلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاغْتَسَلَ ثُمَّ بَكَّرَ وَابْتَكَرَ وَمَشَي وَلَمْ يَرْكَبْ وَدَنَا مِنَ اْلإِمَامِ فَاسْتَمَعَ وَلَمْ يَلْغُ كَانَ لَهُ بِكُلِّ خُطْوَةٍ عَمَلُ سَنَةٍ أَجْرُ صِيَامِهَا وَقِيَامِهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في الغسل للجمعة،رقم:٣٤٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever on the day of Jumu'ah bathes very well, goes to the masjid in the early part of the day walking without riding, sits close to the imam, listens attentively to the khutbah and does not speak any kind of speech at that time, then for every single step he took in coming to the Jumu'ah Salah, he receives the reward of fasting for a year and the reward of standing in worship at night for a year,” Hazrat Aws ibn Aws Thaqafi (RA) has narrated that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ غَسَّلَ وَاغْتَسَلَ وَغَدَا وَابْتَكَرَ وَدَنَا فَاقْتَرَبَ وَاسْتَمَعَ وَأَنْصَتَ كَانَ لَهُ بِكُلِّ خُطْوَةٍ يَخْطُوهَا أَجْرُ قِيَامِ سَنَةٍ وَصِيَامِهَا.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever on the day of Jumu'ah bathes well, goes to the Jumu'ah Salah in the early part of the day, sits very close to the imam, listens attentively to the khutbah and remains silent at that time, then in exchange for every single step he walked in coming to the masjid, he will receive the reward of praying Tahajjud for the whole year
